parts.article:
Part two. You will hear a man giving a presentation about an investment opportunity at a resort. First, you will have some time to look at questions eleven to fifteen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to fifteen.

Welcome, everyone, and thanks for coming in this information event.

My name is Brad Warm. I'm here to tell you how wonderful investment opportunity. The chance is via villa in the Silverstone Resort in the magnificent Banabana National Park.

First, let me tell you the history of Silverstone Resort first.

The Silverstone family has been living in this beautiful Silverstone Park over a hundred years. They settled here back in nineteen oh four.

Until now, they are the only private landowners in the national park,

and they established the hotel here in nineteen eleven. The Banabana is not created in a national park until nineteen oh seven, three years after Silverstone family arrived.

Today, the park covers almost all the oldest trees in Australia, but it is well known for its diverse range of birds. There are over a hundred and sixty species here. While we don't have a high waterfall that other parks are famous for, we do have other attractions such as Tree Talk walking trails and wonderful caves to explore.

So what is so special about our villas? The architects did a fantastic job blending the villa into the surrounding environment and making sure that they are energy efficient, so they are all equipped with solar panels. But I believe what makes it truly unique is that only a few villas ever been built here, so not all people have the opportunity to live here.

Once you bought our villa, you don't need to worry about the gardening. As part of your contract, we take care of that for you and for a small additional fee. When you are not using the villa, you are gonna have a secure income by living and organize the short-term holiday rental service by us.

Now, let me tell you some of the features of the villas. We offer a choice of two designs

and all the villas located in the mountains. It can get a bit colder here, so type A villas features a fireplace for those cold and winter night. The type B villas are located in the same area, but much larger. These villas have a living room downstairs and three bedrooms upstairs. There's a large family-sized bathroom too.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty.

Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.

Now, I'm sure that you are keen to find out the details of this fantastic investment. So if you can all turn your map of the resort, I will tell you the locations and the surroundings of the villas. If you look at the map, you will see the villas on the right at the bottom. To the left of this, you will see a long, low buildings with thick trees next to it. That's our art gallery. You will find some fine landscape buildings there by local painters. Between the villas and the pond, there's a very old building once in Silverstone family's hand. It's now a day spa operating the hair and beauty treatments. There are some advantages of living in this resort like this one. Imagine yourself going to award-winning restaurant in the villa. Just walk past the pond, and it's very easy to find here. As you can see, the restaurant is facing the pond, and you can sit and look around the water, which is live up at night. The first building that most visitors see in the resort is the hotel because it's opposite the car park. Now, is there anything else a problem? Uh, yes, the children's play area. Very important for the little ones. And it is near the villas. Walk from the villas towards the picnic area, and you can come across this area where you can sit under the big trees and watch the kids play. So I hope this is much the idea of where is everything located, and I'm sure you'll get plenty of time to think about it, and I hope to see you soon.

That is the end of part two. You now have forty-five seconds to check your answers to part two.

questions.question: When did Silverton family arrive in the park?

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到Silverston家族在1904年（nineteen o four）就在这里定居了，直接对应选项A。
你可能会因为听到1911和1907而选错，但这分别是他们建立酒店和国家公园成立的年份，做单选题切忌只抓取数字而不听数字背后的对应事件。

The Silverston family has been living in this beautiful Silverston Park over hundred years. They settled here back in nineteen o four. Until now, they are the only private landowners in the national park. And they established the hotel here in nineteen eleven. The Banabana is not created in a national park until nineteen o seven, three years after Silverston family arrived.

questions.question: What is Silverton National Park famous for?

analyses.content: 录音中提到公园因多种多样的鸟类而闻名（well known for its diverse range of birds），对应选项C。
你可能会听到最古老的树（oldest trees）或者瀑布（waterfall），但录音中用“but”进行了转折，且明确否定了有高瀑布，要警惕这些用来干扰的非核心信息。

Today, the park covers almost all the oldest trees in Australia, but it is well known for its diverse range of birds. There are over a hundred and sixty species here. Well, we don't have a high waterfall that other parks are famous for.

options.optionContent: first one to use solar energy

analyses.content: 录音用“truly unique”引出真正特别的地方，即只有少数别墅被建造，并非所有人都有机会住进来，对应选项A的人数限制。
你可能会听到建筑师（architects）和太阳能板（solar panels）就想选B或C，但录音用“But”进行了强转折，说明这些并不是最与众不同的地方。

So what is so special about our villas? The architects did a fantastic job blending the villa into the surrounding environment and making sure that they are energy efficient. So they are all equipped with the solar panels. But I believe what makes it truly unique is that only a few villas ever been built here, so not all people have the opportunity to live here.

questions.question: If you pay extra money, the manager will:

analyses.content: 录音中提到支付一小笔额外费用（a small additional fee），我们就可以为你组织短期的假日出租服务（organize the short-term holiday rental service by us），对应选项B。
你可能会听到不需要担心园艺（gardening）就去选A，但这是合同内包含的基础服务，并不是支付额外费用后提供的主打增值项目。

Once you board our villa, you don't need to worry about the gardening. As part of your contract, we take care of that for you and for a small additional fee. When you are not using the villa, you are gonna have a secure income by living and organize the short-term holiday rental service by us.

questions.question: What feature does type B villas have?

analyses.content: 录音中提到B型别墅有楼下（downstairs）的客厅和楼上（upstairs）的卧室，说明它是两层的，对应选项A。
你可能会听到“three bedrooms”就误选成B（四个卧室）或C（三个地下室），这里是在考察你对具体数字和空间方位词的准确判断，千万别只听一半就着急选。
The type B villas are located in the same area, but much larger. These villas have living room downstairs and three bedrooms upstairs. There's a large family-sized bathroom too.
录音首先定位起点在右下角的别墅（villas on the right at the bottom），然后说在它左边、旁边有茂密树木的长矮建筑就是画廊，对应地图上的E。
做地图题最容易跟丢，你必须先死死咬住“villas”这个核心初始参照物，否则一旦错过“To the left of this”的方位提示，就会完全迷失方向。

If you look at the map, you will see the villas on the right at the bottom. To the left of this, you will see a long, low buildings with the thick trees next to it. That's our art gallery. You will find some fine landscape buildings there by local painters.
录音明确指出水疗中心位于别墅（villas）和池塘（pond）之间，对应地图上处于这两个已知地标中间的C。
你可能会因为没听懂“once its Silverston family's hand”这句补充说明而卡壳，一定要忽略不影响定位的废话，只抓“Between... and...”这种决定性的方位词。
Between the villas and the pond, there's a very old building once its Silverston family's hand. It's now a day spa operating the hair and the beauty treatments.
录音提到走过池塘（walk past the pond），并且餐厅是面向池塘的（facing the pond），对应紧贴着水面的B。
如果你没有紧跟录音中的行进路线，就会在听到“pond”时不知所措，从而在池塘周围的几个选项中随便瞎猜。

Imagine yourself going to award-winning restaurant in a villa. Just walk past the pond, and it's very easy to find here. As you can see, the restaurant is facing the pond, and you can sit and look around the water, which is live up at night.
录音直接且清晰地指出酒店就在停车场（car park）的正对面（opposite），对应地图上的A。
这是一道非常直接的定点题，如果你做错了，说明你读图时根本没有把“car park”这个显眼的已知地标圈出来作为视觉落脚点。
The first building that most visitors see in a resort is the hotel because it's opposite the car park.
录音提示你从别墅（villas）出发，朝着野餐区（picnic area）走，途中遇到的大树下就是儿童游乐区，对应地图上的D。
如果你在最后跑偏了，肯定是因为没有识别出“from... towards...”这个表示动线方向的关键短语，导致视线没有连成一条线。

Uh, yes, the children's play area, very important for the little ones. And it is near the villas. Walk from the villas towards the picnic area, and you can come across this area where you can sit under the big trees and watch the kids play.
